description: Returns a price range for a fence from one GroundQuote contractor's published per-foot rates, gates and removal fee. Nothing is sent to the contractor. If the material/style/height is not offered, returns that contractor's options. Tell the homeowner it is an estimate until the contractor measures on site.

height.description: Height, e.g. "6 ft" or 6. Optional if only one is offered.

linear_feet.description: Total fence length in feet. Ask the homeowner; it is their estimate.

remove_old_fence.description: Tear out and haul away an existing fence

style.description: Style from the contractor's catalog (e.g. "Privacy"). Optional if they offer only one.

name: get_fence_estimate
title: Price a fence from a contractor's own rates
